description: The RJ-42 RTO is a District Transport Office (DTO) serving Kishangarh in the Ajmer district. It handles vehicle registrations, permits, and licensing for the region, which is a major global hub for the marble industry and home to a regional airport.
address: District Transport Office (DTO), Near Krishi-Upaj Mandi, Jaipur Road, Kishangarh, Rajasthan
